mapper.insert: INSERT INTO serve (id, price, city_code, serve_item_id, region_id) VALUES (#{primaryId}, #{price}, #{cityCode}, #{serveItemId}, #{regionId})
mapper.update: update serve set sale_status = 1 where id = #{id}
update serve set status = 1100 where id = #{id}
update serve set price = #{price} where id = #{id}
update serve set sale_status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update serve set is_hot = #{isHot} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select a.id, b.name serveItemName, c.name serveTypeName, b.reference_price referencePrice, a.sale_status saleStatus, a.is_hot isHot, a.price, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.region_id regionId from serve a inner join serve_item b on a.serve_item_id = b.id inner join serve_type c on b.serve_type_id = c.id where a.region_id = #{regionId} and a.status = 1000
select count(*) from serve_item a, serve b where a.id = b.serve_item_id and b.region_id = #{regionId} and a.id = #{serveItemId};
select count(*) from serve where region_id = #{id} and sale_status = #{status}
select count(*) from serve where serve_item_id = #{id} and sale_status = #{status}
